generation.explanation: The graph of y = tan(x) repeats every π and crosses the x-axis at integer multiples of π. Its vertical asymptotes are x = π/2 + kπ: at these values cos(x) = 0, so tan(x) is undefined. As x approaches an asymptote, the curve rises or falls without bound.
